dct_creator_sm: Kumar, Sushil (Faculty of Forestry, University of Toronto).
dct_description_sm: Research in completion of Ph.D.(Forestry) program requirements, University of Toronto

A research study on organizational change, specifically in the Forest Department, India. The questionnaire survey included questions on opinions on a series of statements about the forest department and the experience of working in it. Additional variables include information about service career, demographics, family, educational background, and home environment.
